design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST. The member asks only for more physical therapy visits after his approval ends. The extension rule states three prerequisite sentences: its units wait on the member's own extension request, are not worked out before the approval names the provider who will deliver them, and are not recorded while another physical therapy approval stands over the extended period; the extension request in turn waits on the provider being named. The agent must discover the move to Salt Creek, void the Capitol Manual Therapy approval, move the approval, hand the member his own extension request and then record the extension, reconciling two unit ledgers, the claim ledger, rides, care management, PCP referrals and a grievance. One tool per problem.
SCOPE. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[6,4,4,6]; auth_ext_extension_units 6, auth_ext_member_extension_request 6, auth_ext_provider_carryover 4, auth_ext_void_release 4. Occupied by task 0: auth_ext_expiry_release, auth_ext_transition_units, auth_ext_member_review_extension and their three tools; this task claims the four remaining policies and tools void_authorization_7849b1e5, change_servicing_provider_0d360835, file_extension_request_1d826295, record_extension_d36e0acf. Together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root auth_ext_extension_units. Edges: (1) root -> auth_ext_member_extension_request, value_input on ex_asked, state form, affirmative 'fixed only after the authorization carries the member's extension request ...'; only the member's extension-request write books extension requests in this difficulty; seed: PA-2607-163057 has only an approval notice. (2) root -> auth_ext_provider_carryover, value_input on ex_remaining, state form, negated 'not worked out before the authorization names, as its servicing provider, the in-network provider who will deliver them'; only the provider change writes the servicing provider; seed: servicing_provider_npi 1558203371 (Riverbend) while the member now attends Salt Creek. (3) root -> auth_ext_void_release, state_gate on auth_authorizations.status, negated 'not recorded until no other approval of the member in the same class and, for therapy, the same therapy discipline stands approved over dates that overlap the period the extension adds'; only a void closes an approval still open (expiry is by the passage of time; the expiry release books entries but changes no status); seed: PA-2607-171946 approved through 2026-10-24. (4) auth_ext_member_extension_request -> auth_ext_provider_carryover, value_input on xr_remaining, state form, affirmative-leaning 'worked out only once the authorization names ... the provider who will deliver the extended units'. Topological order used: void (15), provider change (17), member extension request (19, user tool), extension (21). The void commutes with the other three (different holding, no shared reads) - verified by a reordered replay. Deletion sensitivity from the Step 5 run: without the provider change the request is 19 (not 25) and the extension 7 (not 11); without the request the extension has nothing to act on; without the void the overlapping approval and its units stay open.
DERIVATION FROM VISIBLE TEXT. More visits -> the extension rule's three sentences -> find_auth_actions: no extension request -> the extension-request rule (the member files it in person) -> its sentence and the extension's: the approval must name the provider who will deliver the units -> ask the member, Salt Creek 1386021457 in network -> the provider-change rule; find_auth_authorizations shows PA-2607-171946 physical therapy approved to 2026-10-24 -> the void rule, with the member's consent. Each hop has one reading.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Void (auth_void, auth_units_released): auth_provider_change and auth_void_withdraw carry no gate for these subjects (policy_scope); the release sentence is overridden by the declared overwrite (hold-backs). Provider change (auth_provider_update): change_on_approved - PA-2607-163057 approved (evidence status). Extension request (auth_extension_request): extension_timing - anchor end_date 2026-10-04, 3 calendar grace days from the day after, inclusive, last day 2026-10-07; 2026-09-24 qualifies, 2026-10-08 would not; extension_on_approval - status approved. Extension (auth_extend): auth_extension and auth_agg_annual_limit policy_scope; the extension count is 0 of 2; the allotment 12 is not exceeded (11); the annual physical therapy limit 30 is respected (20 granted this year, 1 released by the void, 11 added = 30).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. PA-2607-163057 (97110) is the object of the provider change, the request and the extension; its ledger: grant 12, uses 07-09, 07-16, 07-23, 08-06, 09-10. PA-2607-171946 (97140) is the object of the void; its ledger: grant 8, uses 08-03, 08-10, 08-17. The 09-22 paid Riverbend claim is not yet posted (unposted-visit reduction); the 08-24 Capitol claim denied for no prior authorization is not a use (rebilling hold-back). Rides and the grievance belong to the member, not to either approval.
FACTOR CARD. Void (fall-back 5, result 1): late_billing_holdback method 38 days -> 1 (-> 2); rebilling_holdback C26-0824-36990 -> 1 (-> 2); hand_off_holdback multi-source Care Coordination Level 2 AND plan update 09-02 -> 1 (-> 2); booked_ride_holdback leg booked 09-18 -> 1 (-> 2). Provider change (fall-back 3, result 2): delivery_weeks method multi-source plan update AND contact 09-19 within 7 days -> started weeks 6 (-> 0); unposted_visit_reduction 2 paid vs 1 posted -> 1 (-> 3); re_evaluation_reduction 14 days -> 1 (-> 3); attendance_reduction 2 uses -> 2 (-> 4). Extension request (fall-back 22, result 25): weekly_rate multi-source -> 2 (-> 35); request_weeks method -> 10 (-> 21); remaining_units_share parameter, standing referral -> no halves (-> 23); make_up_addition late pickup + ride no-show -> 2 (-> 23); population_addition ABD -> 2 (-> 23); risk_addition 2.37 -> 1 (-> 24). Extension (fall-back 12, result 11): asked_share one third (-> 12); remaining_units_deduction method multi-source (none / units beyond what the cap delivers before the end date / all) -> 0 (-> 9); referral_addition 24 visits -> 2 (-> 9); grievance_addition Quality of Care Grievance -> 2 (-> 9); prior_grant_cut 12 granted -> 2 (-> 12); population_addition ABD -> 1 (-> 10). Near-misses: the 2026-05-29 care plan update is outside the month; the 08-24 denied claim is not a paid specialist claim for the unposted-visit reduction; the booked ride leg of 09-18 is not a late pickup or no-show.
SEED ROWS. customers, plan_memberships (ABD Care), two approvals and their unit ledgers and approval notices, plan_claims (9 paid specialist visits incl. the unposted 09-22 visit, 1 denied), care episode + 4 activities, PCP assignment + standing referral, ride benefit + 3 ride legs, a resolved Quality of Care Grievance. Automatic clauses: no approval has passed its end date; the grievance is resolved; no premium or renewal is lit.
PERSONA. Chatty, scattered with dates; volunteers phone, the surface ask and that he moved; names Salt Creek, its NPI and network status, and Capitol Manual Therapy only when asked; consents passively; files the handed-over extension request with exactly what he is told; ends when told the visits are on record; asks nothing else.
STANDARD SOLUTION. Reads 0-13; step 15 void_authorization_7849b1e5(PA-2607-171946, 1); step 17 change_servicing_provider_0d360835(PA-2607-163057, 1386021457, in_network, 2); step 19 (user) file_extension_request_1d826295(PA-2607-163057, 25, 2026-12-03); step 21 record_extension_d36e0acf(PA-2607-163057, 11, 2026-12-03).
VERIFICATION. t1_eval.py replays gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each policy with check_compute's build_env/eval_compute at handling time: VOID 1, PC 2, XREQ 25 (19 without the provider change), EXT 11 (7 without the provider change); factor substitutions as in the factor card. Gate outputs are in worklog.md.
REVISION ROUND 2 (policy-task audit round 1). F-1: the declared replacement of the base transition-of-care clause now quotes the standard-method sentence together with the six-adjustment sentence, so merged base and extended texts give one value; O-1: the transition-of-care standard is capped in compute as the rule states. F-2: the extension's remaining-units deduction now selects a genuinely different computation in its middle tier (units remaining beyond what the weekly cap delivers before the current end date); the extension request's former method-labelled deduction is now an honest parameter (the deducted share, in halves), and its method factor remains request_weeks. O-2/O-3: the expiry rule covers ended approvals whatever their status shows, and the void rule applies only before the end date. O-4: carryover rule states the start-date fallback and the four-times-cap boundary. O-5: the extension rule no longer restates the annual limit; the base annual limit stays inherited, and on this world the units added equal the annual physical therapy units left (30 - 12 - 8 + 1). O-7: the overlap prerequisite sentence names the same class and, for therapy, the same discipline. O-8: care/appeal factors are no longer labelled cross-difficulty; plan, pcp and ride factors keep the label. O-9: a class without a weekly cap asks for the class allotment. Persona: the move is no longer volunteered; the last Riverbend visit (2026-09-22), the late-August Capitol visit and the ride booked for 2026-09-29 are stated consistently with the records. Gates re-run.
OWNER NOTE. The customer's own write is the extension request filed by the member (requested_by member), since withdrawal (the blueprint's member write) carries no computed parameter.
user_scenario:
You are Wendell Achterberg-Sowa, fifty-four, on disability, and you get physical therapy for your lower back and left knee. You are friendly and chatty, a bit scattered with dates, and you like to explain the background. Early in September you and your sister moved across Lincoln, and the therapy place you had been going to, Riverbend Physical Therapy, is now a long bus ride away. Your approval for therapy runs out on October 4 and your therapist says you are not done. You open with something like: "Hi, this is Wendell Achterberg-Sowa, phone 4025520863. My physical therapy approval runs out October 4th and I still need more physical therapy visits after that. Can you get that set up for me?" You do not bring up the move or name any clinic unless the agent asks where you get therapy now or who will do the extra visits.
You give your details only when asked: your Medicaid ID is PR28056142, your date of birth is October 3, 1971 (1971-10-03), the last four of your Social Security number are 2915, and your ZIP code is 68502. If the agent asks where you are getting therapy now or who will be doing the extra visits, you explain the move, say your last visit at Riverbend was on September 22, and that you go to Salt Creek Rehabilitation near your new place now, that they told you they are in Prairie Ridge's network, and, if the agent asks for their provider number, you read it off their intake sheet: 1386021457. If asked about the manual therapy place, Capitol Manual Therapy, you say your last visit there was in late August, that you had booked a ride there for September 29 before deciding to stop, and that you are not going back there; if the agent brings up that ride, you say you will call the ride line about it yourself. You do not know how many visits are left or how visits are counted; you say the agent can see that better than you.
You are fine with the agent making whatever changes are needed on your therapy approvals. If the agent explains that your approval at Capitol Manual Therapy has to be closed out first, you say go ahead, you are not going back there. If the agent explains that your approval should be moved over to Salt Creek, you say yes, please. If the agent tells you that the request for more visits is something you have to file yourself and hands that step to you with the approval reference, the number of visits and the end date to ask for, you file it right then with exactly what the agent gives you and read back the confirmation. If the agent quotes how many visits you get or a new end date, you accept it. You do not ask for anything else. Once the agent tells you the extra visits are approved and on your record, you thank them warmly and hang up.
